pages.text:
About the Railway Hotel Jamestown
About the railway HOTEL
Rob McKenzie
The Head Barman
Shelley Woolford
The Master Chef
Your Hosts
Current Licensees Shelley Woolford and Rob McKenzie have been running the Hotel for over 10 years now. Shelley is the "masterchef" in the kitchen, often cooking up a storm, providing the delicious meals on the menu. Rob feels more comfortable "holding up the bar" and enjoys many a conversation with the lcoals and visitors alike.
The Railway s History
141 years young and still an institution
The Railway Hotel has been a Jamestown Institution for over 141 years. The Hotel was was officially licensed in 1878 by W.C. Woidt, only a few years after the township of Jamestown was officially founded by Governor Sir James Fergusson.
We re local & we care!
Supporting the local community
We provide sponsorship to a range of local sporting teams and community events including the Jamestown Show & the Jamestown Races, Black Rock Dirt Circuit, Belman & Bundaleer Cricket Clubs, Jamestown Football, Netball, Tennis, Bowls and many more...
VISIT JAMESTOWN
There is always something happening in Jamestown. Why not come and visit?

Booking and Cancellation Policy
Thank you for your interest in staying at The Railway Hotel Motel Jamestown. Please refer to the following conditions which apply to all accommodation and/or site bookings.
Bookings and Payment:
All room reservations require payment at the time of booking.
Peak Periods:
Minimum 2-night bookings apply for rooms during Easter Holidays, October long weekend, Christmas – New Year and scheduled Community Events. A surcharge may apply for single night bookings during these times. Please enquire with management if you require a single night.
Cancellations:
In the unfortunate event that you have to cancel your stay with us, the following cancellation and refund policy will apply:
Cancellations providing more than 2 days’ notice in relation to your scheduled arrival date are fully refundable. Inside 2 days of scheduled arrival date will result in forfeiture of all monies paid.
Cancellations during peak periods require more than 2 weeks’ notice. Inside this time, no refund will be given, however a credit can be negotiated with management.
PLEASE NOTE: Where a deposit or prepayment is to be refund, a standard administration fee of $5.00 is to be charged. Alternatively, the total refund amount may be transferred to a future booking (to be used within 12 months and subject to availability) and no administration fee will apply.
Refunds may take the form of a credit which can be transferred to another future booking to be used within 12 months. No refunds to be transferred to other bookings.
Check in time for accommodation is from 2pm. Check out time is 10am. This is to allow for cleaning and maintenance. Early check in and late check out may be available at certain times. Please ask management if you require either. Please note: Management reserves the right to change prices without notice however all efforts will be made to honour price quoted when making a booking. Any change to original bookings may involve additional charges being made.
